description: This file defines the ReportDataCollector class responsible for aggregating and collecting report data related to projects, vulnerabilities, assets, and organizations within a software system. It interacts with multiple repositories to gather information and assemble comprehensive data structures used for reporting purposes.

classes.name: ReportDataCollector
classes.description: A service class for collecting and aggregating report data related to projects, vulnerabilities, and organizations in the system.

methods.name: collectForProject
methods.description: Main method to gather all relevant data for a specified project ID, including vulnerabilities, reports, assets, and organization details.

methods.name: createFindingsOverview
methods.description: Creates an overview summary of vulnerabilities categorized by severity.

methods.name: loadDataForOrganisation
methods.description: Loads organization details including logos and contacts based on organization ID.
